findings.note: NC House, third reading of committee substitute, 2018-12-05: yea (tally 67–40); census gate: none.
NC House, veto override, 2018-12-19: yea (tally 72–40); census gate: none.

Listed as a co-sponsor (not a primary sponsor) of House Bill 589, the Voter Information Verification Act. The filed text requires voters to provide photo identification before voting and sets up an advisory board and outreach to help voters without photo ID obtain one. Filed text: https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2013/Bills/House/PDF/H589v0.pdf

findings.motion: HB 589 Voter Information Verification Act, Third Reading, Roll Call #350 (passed 81 to 36)
findings.note: Listed among the Ayes on the House third reading of the photo ID bill HB 589.

findings.motion: HB 589 M11 Concur, Roll Call #1337 (passed 73 to 41): marked as an excused absence, no vote cast
findings.note: On the final House vote to concur with the Senate version of HB 589, she is listed under Excused Absence, so no vote was recorded. The same excused absence is listed on Roll Call #1335 (failed) of the same night.

Primary sponsor of House Bill 396, Repeal Participation in ERIC. It repeals the State Board of Elections' authorization to take part in the Electronic Registration Information Center (a voter-roll data sharing group) and bars joining unless the General Assembly approves. Referred to committee; no further action on the page. Text: https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2023/Bills/House/PDF/H396v1.pdf

Listed as a co-sponsor of House Bill 1074, Constitutional Amendment/Citizens-Only Voting (S.L. 2024-18), which amends the state constitution so that only a citizen of the United States may vote. It does not set a document requirement.

findings.motion: HB 1074 Citizens-Only Voting, Second Reading, Roll Call #731 (passed 104 to 12): excused absence, no vote cast
findings.note: She is listed under Excused Absence on the second reading, and also on Roll Calls #729 and #730 the same day. On the June 27 2024 concurrence vote (Roll Call #769, https://www.ncleg.gov/Legislation/Votes/RollCallVoteTranscript/2023/H/769) she is also listed as excused.

Listed as a primary sponsor (with Ward and Loftis) of House Bill 1231, No Voter Registration Changes At DMV. It ends changes to an existing voter registration (address, name, party) at DMV offices or on the DMV website and requires those changes at county boards of elections. Referred to committee. Text: https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H1231v1.pdf
